description: Initialize a full map when needed or explicitly requested by observe_scene(full_collision_survey=true). A full map requires both arms at the configured pose for all three exposures and publication. With an existing complete map, patch by permanent ID even at the observation pose. Rebuild new or moved obstacles using FoundationPose for registered CAD and masked-depth TSDF for unknown shapes. Retain stationary layers with their original capture, including visible partial surfaces. Keep a moved but unseen layer stale and update only measured anonymous workspace cells.
capability: Publish database-version-bound collision geometry: measured table cuboids, registered CAD and unknown object ESDF from current masked-depth TSDF
